description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Mind Games.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

uses.name: Empowered Autogenerator
uses.cardState: with three or more charge counters on it
